text:Good morning! It is a lovely day to: Good morning! It is a lovely day to give your ideas a voice.
text:Welcome to our little corner of the: Welcome to our little corner of the world. Take a breath, settle in, and let the story begin.
text:This is a new sentence, spoken with: This is a new sentence, spoken with the voice from my reference recording.
text:Upload, record, or use a designed v: Upload, record, or use a designed voice
text:Recording needs microphone permissi: Recording needs microphone permission and localhost or HTTPS.

text:Nine built-in speakers. The 1.7B mo: Nine built-in speakers. The 1.7B model also supports style instructions.
Delivery direction is experimental. Choose Speaker and reference transcript for best results; speaker identity only may ignore the direction. Leave blank to clone without direction.
Delivery direction is experimental. The reference audio and its exact transcript help guide the delivery. Results vary by voice and instruction; leave blank to clone without direction.

text:Whole text gives the model the full: Whole text gives the model the full sentence before speech starts. This is separate from streaming playback.
text:8 frames ≈ 0.67 seconds of audio. S: 8 frames ≈ 0.67 seconds of audio. Smaller chunks reduce the wait for first audio.

text:Native-speaker direction requires 1: Native-speaker direction requires 1.7B CustomVoice. Saved voices use Base with experimental delivery direction.
text:What would you like to hear?: What would you like to hear?
text:Preview and save a progressive MP3: Preview and save a progressive MP3 stream
text:Server first audio includes referen: Server first audio includes reference preparation and audio decoding after model loading. Model TTFA covers model prefill and token generation when reported by streaming. Playback start is scheduled by the browser; it does not measure speaker hardware latency.
text:Describe a voice, listen to a sampl: Describe a voice, listen to a sample, then use it as a cloning reference.
text:Write a short passage that brings o: Write a short passage that brings out the voice you have in mind.

text:The exact words spoken in the refer: The exact words spoken in the reference recording.
text:The words you want the cloned voice: The words you want the cloned voice to say.
text:For example: Speak slowly and gentl: For example: Speak slowly and gently, with a reassuring tone.
text:Only clone speakers who have author: Only clone speakers who have authorized it. Do not use cloned voices for deceptive impersonation.
text:Saved references, portraits and cre: Saved references, portraits and creation settings remain in your local product volume. Use a voice for speech, or refine its original creation settings.
text:Search voices, descriptions, langua: Search voices, descriptions, languages and tags
text:The browser and API use the same se: The browser and API use the same serialized inference engine.
text:Use OpenAI-compatible speech client: Use OpenAI-compatible speech clients, native JSON for text/SSML/SSML-H, or the existing multipart Studio routes. All share one Qwen inference queue.
text:Actual Qwen checkpoints, native spe: Actual Qwen checkpoints, native speakers, compatibility aliases and saved voices.
text:OpenAI-compatible plain-text speech: OpenAI-compatible plain-text speech; MP3, WAV, FLAC, Opus, AAC, Ogg and raw PCM. Saved voices accept delivery instructions.
text:Complete audio, progressive audio o: Complete audio, progressive audio or native SSE. Explicit text, SSML and SSML-H input modes.
text:Validate and inspect the full synth: Validate and inspect the full synthesis plan before loading a model.
text:Exact bounded SSML and SSML-H subse: Exact bounded SSML and SSML-H subset, descriptors and limits.
text:Preview/regenerate turns, reuse loc: Preview/regenerate turns, reuse locked takes and assemble dialogue.
text:Save, edit and use audio-backed voi: Save, edit and use audio-backed voice references.
text:Scripts, folders, settings, takes a: Scripts, folders, settings, takes and explicitly saved audio.
text:Configured external ASR and bounded: Configured external ASR and bounded FFmpeg audio effects.
text:Unload this Studio's model and insp: Unload this Studio's model and inspect NVIDIA telemetry.
text:Keep selected weights in GPU memory: Keep selected weights in GPU memory
text:Choose the default for each workflo: Choose the default for each workflow. Kept models load at startup and stay ready together. Other models unload after the complete request. Voice Design is available at 1.7B only.
text:Unloading releases memory now. Kept: Unloading releases memory now. Kept models load again when used or when you apply defaults.
text:Connect an OpenAI-compatible Qwen3: Connect an OpenAI-compatible Qwen3 ASR service. Audio stays on the service you choose.
text:Connect an agent to the same speech: Connect an agent to the same speech engine. Compact access offers speech and discovery; advanced access also offers design, reference inputs and voice-library changes. Both are off by default.
text:Speech tools return expiring audio: Speech tools return expiring audio links. For clients on another machine, configure the deployment's download origin to a reachable address. The API bearer key also protects MCP when configured.
text:Generated browser audio stays in th: Generated browser audio stays in this page. MCP speech is stored temporarily until its link expires. Voice references are saved to the product volume when you explicitly save them. Prepared references are reused in memory until you unload the model. Models and compiler caches persist in the product volume.
text:Store the selected reference, origi: Store the selected reference, original recording and creation settings in your local library.
text:(PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MB): (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MB)
text:Replace the voice being refined wit: Replace the voice being refined with this new recording
text:Use a speak root. Supported: voice,: Use a speak root. Supported: voice, lang, prosody, break, p, s, sub and bounded say-as. SSML-H adds designed characters and h:direction delivery instructions. Phonemes, remote audio and external lexicons are unsupported.
text:Rate, pitch and volume are audio ef: Rate, pitch and volume are audio effects. Explicit pauses replace the 120 ms turn gap, including 0ms.
text:Audio frames: {0} ≈ {1} seconds. Sm: Audio frames: {0} ≈ {1} seconds. Smaller chunks reduce the wait for first audio.
